secondary_purpose: Check the ranking over a longer interval and evaluate it if the primary interval shows too little endpoint Right routing loss
primary_metric: signed horizontal projection onto R1 contrast over first 10 action positions
ranking: largest minimum of median paired loss on add and median paired recovery on undo, chosen before branch behavior
secondary_native_trigger: right-first-correct drop between step 30 and step 100 is less than 4 of 20
random: per-coordinate random sign on observed delta, preserve original sign where reflection cannot represent the same magnitude in the checkpoint dtype, same draw in add and replace
inference: use each spliced model natively throughout; no changes to activations or predicted actions
